attchmntText: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Sical Logistics sustains revenue performance in Q2 & H1 FY27".
voiceSummary: Sical Logistics Limited filed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs. 1,055 Million in Q2 FY27, up 17.4% year-on-year. Half-year consolidated revenue was Rs. 2,380 Million, up 27.1% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 96 Million in Q2 FY27 with a margin of 9.1%. Half-year consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 345 Million with a margin of 14.5%. The company received a Letter of Acceptance from Central Coalfields Limited on September 1, 2026, for a contract valued at approximately Rs. 5,347 Million over five years. The current order book stands at over Rs. 42,000 Million. The press release was issued on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Sical Logistics Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 rose 17.4% year-on-year to 1,055 million rupees, while H1 FY27 revenue increased 27.1% to 2,380 million rupees. Consolidated EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at 96 million rupees. The company secured a five-year contract with Central Coalfields Limited valued at 5,347 million rupees, inclusive of 18% GST. Fleet expansion additions totaled 779 million rupees, comprising 137 million rupees in owned assets and 642 million rupees in leased equipment. Promoter stake consolidated to 73.41% effective October 1, 2026, following the amalgamation of Pristine Malwa Logistics Park with Pristine Logistics and Infraprojects Limited. The company raised a 910 million rupee credit facility from Tata Capital and a 850 million rupee term loan from Axis Bank to refinance existing debt. Mr. Neeraj was appointed as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Sical Logistics Limited ("Company") has informed the exchange that the board of directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 11, 2026, has considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sical Logistics Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 11, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 1,319 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a profit of 994 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company recorded a profit of 516 lakhs, down from 363 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. Revenue from operations stood at 4,780 lakhs for the quarter and 11,888 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were negative 1.65 rupees for the quarter and 0.65 rupees for the half year. The financial statements were reviewed by M/s CNGSN & Associates LLP, who issued an unmodified review report. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 66,111 lakhs.

attchmntText: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Sical Logistics Limited has dispatched a Postal Ballot Notice on November 11, 2026, seeking shareholder approval for two proposed ordinary resolutions. The first resolution seeks approval for the modification of a material related party transaction with Kanpur Logistics Park Private Limited. The second resolution seeks approval for a material related party transaction with Sical Multimodal and Rail Transport Limited. Voting is conducted via remote electronic means only. The cut-off date for eligibility to vote is Friday, November 06, 2026. The remote e-voting period commences at 09:00 a.m. IST on Friday, November 13, 2026, and concludes at 05:00 p.m. IST on Saturday, December 12, 2026. M/s KRA & Associates has been appointed as the scrutinizer. Results will be declared within two working days from the conclusion of the remote e-voting period.
